text: “最火中秋”盘点：微度假重塑消费方式，国庆假期延续商机｜假日经济 城市微度假与长线出境游双重需求，共同推动了 2026 年中秋假期文旅消费市场的全面升温。
text_en: 'Hottest Mid-Autumn Festival' review: micro-vacations reshape consumption patterns, National Day holiday continues business opportunities | Holiday economy. The dual demand for urban micro-vacations and long-haul outbound travel jointly drove an overall warming of the cultural and tourism consumption market during the 2026 Mid-Autumn Festival holiday.
